ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would be most impacted by a change in phytoplankton?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached food-web diagram shows labeled organism groups connected by arrows. The box labeled “Phytoplankton” is near the lower middle-left. A direct arrow from phytoplankton points to the box labeled “Filter Feeders.” Reasoning: The question asks what would be most impacted by a change in phytoplankton. In this food web, the most directly affected group would be the group that directly depends on phytoplankton for food/energy. Since filter feeders are shown as direct consumers of phytoplankton, they would be most impacted.
